road_users.standing: all represented affected road users, every country
limitations: Gateway mapping and outside legs held fixed; no project-induced change of gateway.
Only already represented through journeys included; missing distant through demand is not estimated.
Commercial classes share the existing car road costs; class-specific restrictions/tolls are not represented.
Source years differ from scenario anchor; historical observed OD validation remains separate.
Original country endpoint tags are not nationality, residence or vehicle ownership; all represented users count.
External road and freight demand are fixed across each paired project; no induced external modal choice or gateway change.
Time annualization retains NB05 shortest congested minus shortest free-flow decomposition; shortest paths may differ.
Resource factors are screening inputs; fuel, tax/fare receipts and class restrictions require their own explicit evidence.
Internal car resource benefit uses matched rule-of-half; its physical totals are weighted exposure, not total consumption changes.
Road costs do not propagate congestion into bus/PT travel times.

external_transit.active_mode_effect: Unchanged original walk/bike/ebike journeys; current projects supply no explicit active-network changes
external_transit.through_transit: Outside-to-outside PT through OD is not provided
external_transit.outside_legs: Fixed outside path segments cancel; proxied anchors held fixed across alternatives
external_transit.route_coverage: Every represented original mode journey retained; identical timetables/outside legs imply exact zero, without routing

reference.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
reference.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

project.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
project.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

reliability.reason: A deterministic assignment is not a travel-time variability model. NISTRA/EBeN reliability requires supported motorway/incident data; new single-lane bypass is outside the official simplified tool application.

classification.type_source: ARE, NPVM zones/networks report 20 July 2018, table22 pp65-67; NPVM type0-19 motorway/autostrasse,29-37 and50-61 urban, 20-28 and38-49 rural,62-73 motorway ramps
classification.overlap_policy: Retain every assigned physical edge traversal; shared source geometry alone is not a duplicate journey
classification.built_fraction_basis: EBeN2024 p37: urban100%,motorway22%,rural0%; a national proxy, not measured receptor exposure
classification.noise_basis: All base physical road distance except registered existing tunnel; new uninhabited bypass excluded as explicit project assumption; sensitivity allows25% exposure
classification.synthetic_connectors: connector:, gate:, border:inbound/outbound excluded; border-road: physical edges retained
limitations: Unregistered existing tunnels remain national-average exposure; no receptor or tunnel-portal dispersion model
No imported segment permissions or speed-dependent emissions; physical inventory does not alter assignment

a15_uster_hinwil.notes: Motorway class; zero direct tunnel surface noise; retained split approaches inherit source class. Tunnel portals and construction emissions unmodelled.

simplified_externalities.rail_cost_scope: Illustrative regional electric multiple unit, national/international traction electricity mix sensitivity; not an operator quote. Nonenergy vehicle cost covers maintenance and rolling-stock resource use; excludes crew, traction energy, track access transfers and infrastructure O&M, which are separate.

road_users.standing: all represented affected road users, every country
limitations: Gateway mapping and outside legs held fixed; no project-induced change of gateway.
Only already represented through journeys included; missing distant through demand is not estimated.
Commercial classes share the existing car road costs; class-specific restrictions/tolls are not represented.
Source years differ from scenario anchor; historical observed OD validation remains separate.
Original country endpoint tags are not nationality, residence or vehicle ownership; all represented users count.
External road and freight demand are fixed across each paired project; no induced external modal choice or gateway change.
Time annualization retains NB05 shortest congested minus shortest free-flow decomposition; shortest paths may differ.
Resource factors are screening inputs; fuel, tax/fare receipts and class restrictions require their own explicit evidence.
Internal car resource benefit uses matched rule-of-half; its physical totals are weighted exposure, not total consumption changes.
Road costs do not propagate congestion into bus/PT travel times.

external_transit.active_mode_effect: Unchanged original walk/bike/ebike journeys; current projects supply no explicit active-network changes
external_transit.through_transit: Outside-to-outside PT through OD is not provided
external_transit.outside_legs: Fixed outside path segments cancel; proxied anchors held fixed across alternatives
external_transit.route_coverage: Every represented original mode journey retained; identical timetables/outside legs imply exact zero, without routing

reference.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
reference.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

project.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
project.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

reliability.reason: A deterministic assignment is not a travel-time variability model. NISTRA/EBeN reliability requires supported motorway/incident data; new single-lane bypass is outside the official simplified tool application.

classification.type_source: ARE, NPVM zones/networks report 20 July 2018, table22 pp65-67; NPVM type0-19 motorway/autostrasse,29-37 and50-61 urban, 20-28 and38-49 rural,62-73 motorway ramps
classification.overlap_policy: Retain every assigned physical edge traversal; shared source geometry alone is not a duplicate journey
classification.built_fraction_basis: EBeN2024 p37: urban100%,motorway22%,rural0%; a national proxy, not measured receptor exposure
classification.noise_basis: All base physical road distance except registered existing tunnel; new uninhabited bypass excluded as explicit project assumption; sensitivity allows25% exposure
classification.synthetic_connectors: connector:, gate:, border:inbound/outbound excluded; border-road: physical edges retained
limitations: Unregistered existing tunnels remain national-average exposure; no receptor or tunnel-portal dispersion model
No imported segment permissions or speed-dependent emissions; physical inventory does not alter assignment

a15_uster_hinwil.notes: Motorway class; zero direct tunnel surface noise; retained split approaches inherit source class. Tunnel portals and construction emissions unmodelled.

simplified_externalities.rail_cost_scope: Illustrative regional electric multiple unit, national/international traction electricity mix sensitivity; not an operator quote. Nonenergy vehicle cost covers maintenance and rolling-stock resource use; excludes crew, traction energy, track access transfers and infrastructure O&M, which are separate.

road_users.standing: all represented affected road users, every country
limitations: Gateway mapping and outside legs held fixed; no project-induced change of gateway.
Only already represented through journeys included; missing distant through demand is not estimated.
Commercial classes share the existing car road costs; class-specific restrictions/tolls are not represented.
Source years differ from scenario anchor; historical observed OD validation remains separate.
Original country endpoint tags are not nationality, residence or vehicle ownership; all represented users count.
External road and freight demand are fixed across each paired project; no induced external modal choice or gateway change.
Time annualization retains NB05 shortest congested minus shortest free-flow decomposition; shortest paths may differ.
Resource factors are screening inputs; fuel, tax/fare receipts and class restrictions require their own explicit evidence.
Internal car resource benefit uses matched rule-of-half; its physical totals are weighted exposure, not total consumption changes.
Road costs do not propagate congestion into bus/PT travel times.

external_transit.active_mode_effect: Unchanged original walk/bike/ebike journeys; current projects supply no explicit active-network changes
external_transit.through_transit: Outside-to-outside PT through OD is not provided
external_transit.outside_legs: Fixed outside path segments cancel; proxied anchors held fixed across alternatives
external_transit.route_coverage: Every represented original mode journey retained; identical timetables/outside legs imply exact zero, without routing

reference.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
reference.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

project.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
project.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

reliability.reason: A deterministic assignment is not a travel-time variability model. NISTRA/EBeN reliability requires supported motorway/incident data; new single-lane bypass is outside the official simplified tool application.

classification.type_source: ARE, NPVM zones/networks report 20 July 2018, table22 pp65-67; NPVM type0-19 motorway/autostrasse,29-37 and50-61 urban, 20-28 and38-49 rural,62-73 motorway ramps
classification.overlap_policy: Retain every assigned physical edge traversal; shared source geometry alone is not a duplicate journey
classification.built_fraction_basis: EBeN2024 p37: urban100%,motorway22%,rural0%; a national proxy, not measured receptor exposure
classification.noise_basis: All base physical road distance except registered existing tunnel; new uninhabited bypass excluded as explicit project assumption; sensitivity allows25% exposure
classification.synthetic_connectors: connector:, gate:, border:inbound/outbound excluded; border-road: physical edges retained
limitations: Unregistered existing tunnels remain national-average exposure; no receptor or tunnel-portal dispersion model
No imported segment permissions or speed-dependent emissions; physical inventory does not alter assignment

a15_uster_hinwil.notes: Motorway class; zero direct tunnel surface noise; retained split approaches inherit source class. Tunnel portals and construction emissions unmodelled.

simplified_externalities.rail_cost_scope: Illustrative regional electric multiple unit, national/international traction electricity mix sensitivity; not an operator quote. Nonenergy vehicle cost covers maintenance and rolling-stock resource use; excludes crew, traction energy, track access transfers and infrastructure O&M, which are separate.

road_users.standing: all represented affected road users, every country
limitations: Gateway mapping and outside legs held fixed; no project-induced change of gateway.
Only already represented through journeys included; missing distant through demand is not estimated.
Commercial classes share the existing car road costs; class-specific restrictions/tolls are not represented.
Source years differ from scenario anchor; historical observed OD validation remains separate.
Original country endpoint tags are not nationality, residence or vehicle ownership; all represented users count.
External road and freight demand are fixed across each paired project; no induced external modal choice or gateway change.
Time annualization retains NB05 shortest congested minus shortest free-flow decomposition; shortest paths may differ.
Resource factors are screening inputs; fuel, tax/fare receipts and class restrictions require their own explicit evidence.
Internal car resource benefit uses matched rule-of-half; its physical totals are weighted exposure, not total consumption changes.
Road costs do not propagate congestion into bus/PT travel times.

external_transit.active_mode_effect: Unchanged original walk/bike/ebike journeys; current projects supply no explicit active-network changes
external_transit.through_transit: Outside-to-outside PT through OD is not provided
external_transit.outside_legs: Fixed outside path segments cancel; proxied anchors held fixed across alternatives
external_transit.route_coverage: Every represented original mode journey retained; identical timetables/outside legs imply exact zero, without routing

reference.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
reference.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

project.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
project.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

reliability.reason: A deterministic assignment is not a travel-time variability model. NISTRA/EBeN reliability requires supported motorway/incident data; new single-lane bypass is outside the official simplified tool application.

classification.type_source: ARE, NPVM zones/networks report 20 July 2018, table22 pp65-67; NPVM type0-19 motorway/autostrasse,29-37 and50-61 urban, 20-28 and38-49 rural,62-73 motorway ramps
classification.overlap_policy: Retain every assigned physical edge traversal; shared source geometry alone is not a duplicate journey
classification.built_fraction_basis: EBeN2024 p37: urban100%,motorway22%,rural0%; a national proxy, not measured receptor exposure
classification.noise_basis: All base physical road distance except registered existing tunnel; new uninhabited bypass excluded as explicit project assumption; sensitivity allows25% exposure
classification.synthetic_connectors: connector:, gate:, border:inbound/outbound excluded; border-road: physical edges retained
limitations: Unregistered existing tunnels remain national-average exposure; no receptor or tunnel-portal dispersion model
No imported segment permissions or speed-dependent emissions; physical inventory does not alter assignment

a15_uster_hinwil.notes: Motorway class; zero direct tunnel surface noise; retained split approaches inherit source class. Tunnel portals and construction emissions unmodelled.

simplified_externalities.rail_cost_scope: Illustrative regional electric multiple unit, national/international traction electricity mix sensitivity; not an operator quote. Nonenergy vehicle cost covers maintenance and rolling-stock resource use; excludes crew, traction energy, track access transfers and infrastructure O&M, which are separate.

road_users.standing: all represented affected road users, every country
limitations: Gateway mapping and outside legs held fixed; no project-induced change of gateway.
Only already represented through journeys included; missing distant through demand is not estimated.
Commercial classes share the existing car road costs; class-specific restrictions/tolls are not represented.
Source years differ from scenario anchor; historical observed OD validation remains separate.
Original country endpoint tags are not nationality, residence or vehicle ownership; all represented users count.
External road and freight demand are fixed across each paired project; no induced external modal choice or gateway change.
Time annualization retains NB05 shortest congested minus shortest free-flow decomposition; shortest paths may differ.
Resource factors are screening inputs; fuel, tax/fare receipts and class restrictions require their own explicit evidence.
Internal car resource benefit uses matched rule-of-half; its physical totals are weighted exposure, not total consumption changes.
Road costs do not propagate congestion into bus/PT travel times.

external_transit.active_mode_effect: Unchanged original walk/bike/ebike journeys; current projects supply no explicit active-network changes
external_transit.through_transit: Outside-to-outside PT through OD is not provided
external_transit.outside_legs: Fixed outside path segments cancel; proxied anchors held fixed across alternatives
external_transit.route_coverage: Every represented original mode journey retained; identical timetables/outside legs imply exact zero, without routing

reference.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
reference.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

project.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
project.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

reliability.reason: A deterministic assignment is not a travel-time variability model. NISTRA/EBeN reliability requires supported motorway/incident data; new single-lane bypass is outside the official simplified tool application.

classification.type_source: ARE, NPVM zones/networks report 20 July 2018, table22 pp65-67; NPVM type0-19 motorway/autostrasse,29-37 and50-61 urban, 20-28 and38-49 rural,62-73 motorway ramps
classification.overlap_policy: Retain every assigned physical edge traversal; shared source geometry alone is not a duplicate journey
classification.built_fraction_basis: EBeN2024 p37: urban100%,motorway22%,rural0%; a national proxy, not measured receptor exposure
classification.noise_basis: All base physical road distance except registered existing tunnel; new uninhabited bypass excluded as explicit project assumption; sensitivity allows25% exposure
classification.synthetic_connectors: connector:, gate:, border:inbound/outbound excluded; border-road: physical edges retained
limitations: Unregistered existing tunnels remain national-average exposure; no receptor or tunnel-portal dispersion model
No imported segment permissions or speed-dependent emissions; physical inventory does not alter assignment

a15_uster_hinwil.notes: Motorway class; zero direct tunnel surface noise; retained split approaches inherit source class. Tunnel portals and construction emissions unmodelled.

simplified_externalities.rail_cost_scope: Illustrative regional electric multiple unit, national/international traction electricity mix sensitivity; not an operator quote. Nonenergy vehicle cost covers maintenance and rolling-stock resource use; excludes crew, traction energy, track access transfers and infrastructure O&M, which are separate.

road_users.standing: all represented affected road users, every country
limitations: Gateway mapping and outside legs held fixed; no project-induced change of gateway.
Only already represented through journeys included; missing distant through demand is not estimated.
Commercial classes share the existing car road costs; class-specific restrictions/tolls are not represented.
Source years differ from scenario anchor; historical observed OD validation remains separate.
Original country endpoint tags are not nationality, residence or vehicle ownership; all represented users count.
External road and freight demand are fixed across each paired project; no induced external modal choice or gateway change.
Time annualization retains NB05 shortest congested minus shortest free-flow decomposition; shortest paths may differ.
Resource factors are screening inputs; fuel, tax/fare receipts and class restrictions require their own explicit evidence.
Internal car resource benefit uses matched rule-of-half; its physical totals are weighted exposure, not total consumption changes.
Road costs do not propagate congestion into bus/PT travel times.

external_transit.active_mode_effect: Unchanged original walk/bike/ebike journeys; current projects supply no explicit active-network changes
external_transit.through_transit: Outside-to-outside PT through OD is not provided
external_transit.outside_legs: Fixed outside path segments cancel; proxied anchors held fixed across alternatives
external_transit.route_coverage: Every represented original mode journey retained; identical timetables/outside legs imply exact zero, without routing

reference.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
reference.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

project.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
project.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

reliability.reason: A deterministic assignment is not a travel-time variability model. NISTRA/EBeN reliability requires supported motorway/incident data; new single-lane bypass is outside the official simplified tool application.

classification.type_source: ARE, NPVM zones/networks report 20 July 2018, table22 pp65-67; NPVM type0-19 motorway/autostrasse,29-37 and50-61 urban, 20-28 and38-49 rural,62-73 motorway ramps
classification.overlap_policy: Retain every assigned physical edge traversal; shared source geometry alone is not a duplicate journey
classification.built_fraction_basis: EBeN2024 p37: urban100%,motorway22%,rural0%; a national proxy, not measured receptor exposure
classification.noise_basis: All base physical road distance except registered existing tunnel; new uninhabited bypass excluded as explicit project assumption; sensitivity allows25% exposure
classification.synthetic_connectors: connector:, gate:, border:inbound/outbound excluded; border-road: physical edges retained
limitations: Unregistered existing tunnels remain national-average exposure; no receptor or tunnel-portal dispersion model
No imported segment permissions or speed-dependent emissions; physical inventory does not alter assignment

a15_uster_hinwil.notes: Motorway class; zero direct tunnel surface noise; retained split approaches inherit source class. Tunnel portals and construction emissions unmodelled.

simplified_externalities.rail_cost_scope: Illustrative regional electric multiple unit, national/international traction electricity mix sensitivity; not an operator quote. Nonenergy vehicle cost covers maintenance and rolling-stock resource use; excludes crew, traction energy, track access transfers and infrastructure O&M, which are separate.

road_users.standing: all represented affected road users, every country
limitations: Gateway mapping and outside legs held fixed; no project-induced change of gateway.
Only already represented through journeys included; missing distant through demand is not estimated.
Commercial classes share the existing car road costs; class-specific restrictions/tolls are not represented.
Source years differ from scenario anchor; historical observed OD validation remains separate.
Original country endpoint tags are not nationality, residence or vehicle ownership; all represented users count.
External road and freight demand are fixed across each paired project; no induced external modal choice or gateway change.
Time annualization retains NB05 shortest congested minus shortest free-flow decomposition; shortest paths may differ.
Resource factors are screening inputs; fuel, tax/fare receipts and class restrictions require their own explicit evidence.
Internal car resource benefit uses matched rule-of-half; its physical totals are weighted exposure, not total consumption changes.
Road costs do not propagate congestion into bus/PT travel times.

external_transit.active_mode_effect: Unchanged original walk/bike/ebike journeys; current projects supply no explicit active-network changes
external_transit.through_transit: Outside-to-outside PT through OD is not provided
external_transit.outside_legs: Fixed outside path segments cancel; proxied anchors held fixed across alternatives
external_transit.route_coverage: Every represented original mode journey retained; identical timetables/outside legs imply exact zero, without routing

reference.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
reference.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

project.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
project.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

reliability.reason: A deterministic assignment is not a travel-time variability model. NISTRA/EBeN reliability requires supported motorway/incident data; new single-lane bypass is outside the official simplified tool application.

classification.type_source: ARE, NPVM zones/networks report 20 July 2018, table22 pp65-67; NPVM type0-19 motorway/autostrasse,29-37 and50-61 urban, 20-28 and38-49 rural,62-73 motorway ramps
classification.overlap_policy: Retain every assigned physical edge traversal; shared source geometry alone is not a duplicate journey
classification.built_fraction_basis: EBeN2024 p37: urban100%,motorway22%,rural0%; a national proxy, not measured receptor exposure
classification.noise_basis: All base physical road distance except registered existing tunnel; new uninhabited bypass excluded as explicit project assumption; sensitivity allows25% exposure
classification.synthetic_connectors: connector:, gate:, border:inbound/outbound excluded; border-road: physical edges retained
limitations: Unregistered existing tunnels remain national-average exposure; no receptor or tunnel-portal dispersion model
No imported segment permissions or speed-dependent emissions; physical inventory does not alter assignment

a15_uster_hinwil.notes: Motorway class; zero direct tunnel surface noise; retained split approaches inherit source class. Tunnel portals and construction emissions unmodelled.

simplified_externalities.rail_cost_scope: Illustrative regional electric multiple unit, national/international traction electricity mix sensitivity; not an operator quote. Nonenergy vehicle cost covers maintenance and rolling-stock resource use; excludes crew, traction energy, track access transfers and infrastructure O&M, which are separate.

road_users.standing: all represented affected road users, every country
limitations: Gateway mapping and outside legs held fixed; no project-induced change of gateway.
Only already represented through journeys included; missing distant through demand is not estimated.
Commercial classes share the existing car road costs; class-specific restrictions/tolls are not represented.
Source years differ from scenario anchor; historical observed OD validation remains separate.
Original country endpoint tags are not nationality, residence or vehicle ownership; all represented users count.
External road and freight demand are fixed across each paired project; no induced external modal choice or gateway change.
Time annualization retains NB05 shortest congested minus shortest free-flow decomposition; shortest paths may differ.
Resource factors are screening inputs; fuel, tax/fare receipts and class restrictions require their own explicit evidence.
Internal car resource benefit uses matched rule-of-half; its physical totals are weighted exposure, not total consumption changes.
Road costs do not propagate congestion into bus/PT travel times.

external_transit.active_mode_effect: Unchanged original walk/bike/ebike journeys; current projects supply no explicit active-network changes
external_transit.through_transit: Outside-to-outside PT through OD is not provided
external_transit.outside_legs: Fixed outside path segments cancel; proxied anchors held fixed across alternatives
external_transit.route_coverage: Every represented original mode journey retained; identical timetables/outside legs imply exact zero, without routing

reference.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
reference.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

project.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
project.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

reliability.reason: A deterministic assignment is not a travel-time variability model. NISTRA/EBeN reliability requires supported motorway/incident data; new single-lane bypass is outside the official simplified tool application.

classification.type_source: ARE, NPVM zones/networks report 20 July 2018, table22 pp65-67; NPVM type0-19 motorway/autostrasse,29-37 and50-61 urban, 20-28 and38-49 rural,62-73 motorway ramps
classification.overlap_policy: Retain every assigned physical edge traversal; shared source geometry alone is not a duplicate journey
classification.built_fraction_basis: EBeN2024 p37: urban100%,motorway22%,rural0%; a national proxy, not measured receptor exposure
classification.noise_basis: All base physical road distance except registered existing tunnel; new uninhabited bypass excluded as explicit project assumption; sensitivity allows25% exposure
classification.synthetic_connectors: connector:, gate:, border:inbound/outbound excluded; border-road: physical edges retained
limitations: Unregistered existing tunnels remain national-average exposure; no receptor or tunnel-portal dispersion model
No imported segment permissions or speed-dependent emissions; physical inventory does not alter assignment

a15_uster_hinwil.notes: Motorway class; zero direct tunnel surface noise; retained split approaches inherit source class. Tunnel portals and construction emissions unmodelled.

simplified_externalities.rail_cost_scope: Illustrative regional electric multiple unit, national/international traction electricity mix sensitivity; not an operator quote. Nonenergy vehicle cost covers maintenance and rolling-stock resource use; excludes crew, traction energy, track access transfers and infrastructure O&M, which are separate.

road_users.standing: all represented affected road users, every country
limitations: Gateway mapping and outside legs held fixed; no project-induced change of gateway.
Only already represented through journeys included; missing distant through demand is not estimated.
Commercial classes share the existing car road costs; class-specific restrictions/tolls are not represented.
Source years differ from scenario anchor; historical observed OD validation remains separate.
Original country endpoint tags are not nationality, residence or vehicle ownership; all represented users count.
External road and freight demand are fixed across each paired project; no induced external modal choice or gateway change.
Time annualization retains NB05 shortest congested minus shortest free-flow decomposition; shortest paths may differ.
Resource factors are screening inputs; fuel, tax/fare receipts and class restrictions require their own explicit evidence.
Internal car resource benefit uses matched rule-of-half; its physical totals are weighted exposure, not total consumption changes.
Road costs do not propagate congestion into bus/PT travel times.

external_transit.active_mode_effect: Unchanged original walk/bike/ebike journeys; current projects supply no explicit active-network changes
external_transit.through_transit: Outside-to-outside PT through OD is not provided
external_transit.outside_legs: Fixed outside path segments cancel; proxied anchors held fixed across alternatives
external_transit.route_coverage: Every represented original mode journey retained; identical timetables/outside legs imply exact zero, without routing

reference.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
reference.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

project.class_flow_method: Every aggregate assigned link split by regional original-OD class proportions; native source peak shares applied before aggregation. Exact aggregate flow conservation, not class-specific routing.
project.intra_zone_distance: Unloaded diagonal demand omitted; no synthetic centroid distance counted as a real-road environmental footprint

reliability.reason: A deterministic assignment is not a travel-time variability model. NISTRA/EBeN reliability requires supported motorway/incident data; new single-lane bypass is outside the official simplified tool application.

classification.type_source: ARE, NPVM zones/networks report 20 July 2018, table22 pp65-67; NPVM type0-19 motorway/autostrasse,29-37 and50-61 urban, 20-28 and38-49 rural,62-73 motorway ramps
classification.overlap_policy: Retain every assigned physical edge traversal; shared source geometry alone is not a duplicate journey
classification.built_fraction_basis: EBeN2024 p37: urban100%,motorway22%,rural0%; a national proxy, not measured receptor exposure
classification.noise_basis: All base physical road distance except registered existing tunnel; new uninhabited bypass excluded as explicit project assumption; sensitivity allows25% exposure
classification.synthetic_connectors: connector:, gate:, border:inbound/outbound excluded; border-road: physical edges retained
limitations: Unregistered existing tunnels remain national-average exposure; no receptor or tunnel-portal dispersion model
No imported segment permissions or speed-dependent emissions; physical inventory does not alter assignment

a15_uster_hinwil.notes: Motorway class; zero direct tunnel surface noise; retained split approaches inherit source class. Tunnel portals and construction emissions unmodelled.

simplified_externalities.rail_cost_scope: Illustrative regional electric multiple unit, national/international traction electricity mix sensitivity; not an operator quote. Nonenergy vehicle cost covers maintenance and rolling-stock resource use; excludes crew, traction energy, track access transfers and infrastructure O&M, which are separate.
